items.title_fr: “Wonderful Waters” Mini Tins Revealed for January!
items.summary_fr: A nouveau set of TCG mini tins named "Wonderful Waters" will release on January 29th! As usual, they will cost $9.99 each. They'll include two booster packs, a sticker sheet, an art card of the tin's illustration, and a code card.

items.title_fr: “Aura Seeker” All 78 Main Set Cards Revealed!
items.summary_fr: All 78 main set cards from Aura Seeker have been officially revealed! The set stars Mega Lucario Z ex and will release in Japan on November 27th as their seventh Mega Evolution set. This is the first set to feature the Z Mega Evolutions from the Mega Dimension DLC.

items.title_fr: Official illustration of All “Legends: Z-A” Mega Evolutions Revealed!
items.summary_fr: All of the "Ken Sugimori" illustration of the new Mega Evolutions from Legends: Z-A have been revealed by the official Japanese Pokedex . The base game released 90 days ago while the DLC, Mega Dimension, released 34 days ago. Mega Garchomp Z's illustration hasn't been revealed yet, so it's the only one missing.

items.title_fr: “Flowing Fists” TCG Set Officially Revealed for February, Full Product Lineup Revealed!
items.summary_fr: Flowing Fists starring Mega Lucario Z ex has now been officially revealed! It will release on Saturday, February 6th as our seventh English Mega Evolution set. This marks the first time a set will release on a Saturday.

items.title_fr: “Aura Seeker” Set Starring Mega Lucario Z ex Officially Revealed!
items.summary_fr: Aura Seeker starring Mega Lucario Z ex has now been officially revealed! As posted before, it will release in Japan on November 27th as their M7 set. This is the first set to feature the Z Mega Evolutions from the Mega Dimension DLC.

items.title_fr: Zelda Switch 2 Console Is Back en stock Soon If You Missed Out (US)
items.summary_fr: Just hold on a little while longer. If you live in the US and happened to miss out on the Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 console, then good news – more is on the way. This was already kind of confirmed in a recent interview with Nintendo's Latin America Vice President and General Manager Bill van Zyll, in which he claimed Nintendo "underestimated" how popular the hardware would be, but promised that more would come at a later date.
